samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for contacting me about online university classes. I am writing to offer some suggestions in response to your request. I understand that you would like a practical starting point, and I hope the following advice will be useful.

paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending an online study workshop. This would give you an opportunity to try a short recorded lesson and discuss it in a small group. One potential benefit is that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift.

Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for contacting me about school libraries. I am writing to offer some suggestions in response to your request. I understand that you would like a practical starting point, and I hope the following advice will be useful.

paragraphs.label: Đề xuất đầu
paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a school library open day. This would give you an opportunity to explore the shelves and practise finding useful books. One potential benefit is that students have a quiet place to study without buying every book. For example, two students can use a library reference book to prepare a science presentation after school.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for contacting me about homework for schoolchildren. I am writing to offer some suggestions in response to your request. I understand that you would like a practical starting point, and I hope the following advice will be useful.

paragraphs.label: Đề xuất đầu
paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a homework planning session. This would give you an opportunity to design a simple weekly study plan and discuss useful practice tasks. One potential benefit is that children can practise a skill after learning it in class. For example, five carefully chosen maths questions can reveal whether a pupil knows how to use a new method.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for contacting me about studying English with a partner. I am writing to offer some suggestions in response to your request. I understand that you would like a practical starting point, and I hope the following advice will be useful.

paragraphs.label: Đề xuất đầu
paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending an English conversation club meeting. This would give you an opportunity to practise everyday dialogues with a partner. One potential benefit is that learners have more opportunities to speak. For example, two friends can exchange short voice messages about their day and discuss one useful phrase each evening.

paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a healthy study habits session. This would give you an opportunity to test a study routine with short planned breaks. One potential benefit is that students can return to work with better attention. For example, after a demanding writing task, pupils can stretch for a few minutes before reviewing their work.

paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a school uniform exchange event. This would give you an opportunity to sort donated clothes and discuss affordable uniform choices.
